title: Skip the Compressor: Coding Agents Fix More Issues When They Pick Whole Files
abstract: arXiv:2610.21073v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A coding agent works on repositories that can be far larger than its context window can hold. Prompt compressors and retrievers offer solutions to this problem, but patching an issue needs two things at once: the files that must change, and their code exactly as written, since the model must reproduce the lines it edits. Retrievers rank code by its similarity to the issue rather than by whether it must change, and compressors delete text to fit the budget. We show that at an equal token budget, an agent resolves more issues when the budget goes to choosing which files to show verbatim, as our simple selector CQ2-CARE does, than when it goes to pruning tokens or retrieving chunks. We fit every context to the same per-issue budget on 300 recent SWE-rebench issues and grade each patch with the benchmark's tests. With GPT-5.6 and Claude Opus 5, CQ2-CARE resolves 43.7% and 46.7% of the issues, 6.3 points more than the best of three compressor

translated_title: 跳过压缩器：编码代理在选择完整文件时能修复更多问题
translated_abstract: 编码代理所处理的代码库可能远超其上下文窗口的容量。提示压缩器和检索器为这一问题提供了解决方案，但修补一个问题需要同时满足两点：必须修改的文件，以及这些文件中原样保留的代码，因为模型必须复现它所编辑的代码行。检索器按照代码与问题的相似度而非是否必须修改来对代码排序，而压缩器则通过删除文本来适应预算限制。我们证明，在相同的token预算下，当预算用于选择哪些文件以原文完整呈现时（正如我们简单的选择器CQ2-CARE所做的那样），代理能解决更多问题，其效果优于将预算用于修剪token或检索代码块。我们在300个最新的SWE-rebench问题上将每个上下文都调整到相同的单问题预算，并使用基准测试的测试用例对每个补丁进行评分。使用GPT-5.6和Claude Opus 5时，CQ2-CARE分别解决了43.7%和46.7%的问题，比三种压缩器中最好的一个高出6.3个百分点。
tldr: 在相同token预算下，与其用压缩器删减文本或检索器挑选代码块，不如将预算用于选择需要原样完整呈现的文件（如CQ2-CARE），这样编码代理能解决更多软件工程问题。
en_tdlr: At equal token budgets, coding agents resolve more issues when the budget is spent on picking whole files to show verbatim, as CQ2-CARE does, rather than on compressing tokens or retrieving code chunks.
